title: Defining, Understanding, and Detecting Online Toxicity: Challenges and Machine Learning Approaches

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and synthesis of datasets and machine learning models focused on detecting racism, race-based hate speech, and ethnic discrimination.
Reviewing existing publications and datasets that cover Islamophobia, anti-Muslim sentiment, and religious intolerance.
Analyzing and categorizing research datasets that target misogyny, sexism, and appearance-based or intellectual bias against women.
Surveying machine learning datasets that include hate speech directed towards LGBTQ+ communities and sexuality-related hate.
Identifying and synthesizing datasets within the literature that capture hate and discrimination towards individuals with disabilities or health conditions.
Evaluating datasets focused on xenophobia and toxic discourse targeting immigrants, migrants, and refugees across various platforms.
